name: council_board_digest
description: Read the Task Council board (qsb_council_tasks_snapshot.json): totals by state, and the top open/claimed tasks with owner, age, priority and any SLA-breach flag. Lets Wren actually DRIVE the council — see what's stuck, who owns it, what's breaching SLA — instead of being blind to the board. Read-only; to create/claim tasks Wren still uses tools/qsb_council_tasks.py (this skill tells her WHAT to act on).
